summary: Post-market Friday: equities absorbed a fresh leg higher in yields. The composite score rose 0.80 to 45.48 (caution, goldilocks regime) even as 13 of 22 sectors/themes closed positive, led by AI Infrastructure +1.897, Semiconductor Equipment +1.5281 and Networking +1.2374, while Cybersecurity -2.132, Autos -1.7596 and Cloud Computing -1.1863 lagged. The macro block hardened again: the newest FRED vintage (dated 2026-09-23) puts the 10-year at 5.11 from 4.96, the 2-year at 4.85 from 4.71 and the 10-year real rate at 2.76, the 100th percentile, and the FedWatch-implied 4.175 versus the effective 3.88 keeps a hike priced. Volatility moved the other way: VIX eased to 14.21 from 14.87 and cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.625. Liquidity thinned at the edges (reverse repo 0.576 from 0.63; bank reserves down 83601 to 2930193 as the Treasury account rebuilt 100056 to 977084) and the oil premium thinned on Iran memorandum headlines. A narrow, hardware-led tape into Monday's FOMC.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Discount rates re-priced hard: on the newest FRED vintage (2026-09-23) the 10-year rose to 5.11 from 4.96 and the 2-year to 4.85 from 4.71, lifting the macro dimension to 68.5 — the largest block in the composite.

The real-rate squeeze persists: the 10-year real rate climbed to 2.76, the 100th percentile, while the FedWatch-implied 4.175 against the effective 3.88 keeps a hike priced, and Fed speakers (Hammack) argued policy must stay restrictive because underlying inflation may run above target.
Liquidity thinned: reverse repo slipped to 0.576 from 0.63, bank reserves fell 83601 to 2930193 while the Treasury general account rebuilt 100056 to 977084, and HY OAS widened to 2.8 from 2.73.
Market structure stayed narrow: new highs at 0.0387 trail new lows at 0.0452, breadth above the 200-day sits at 0.6, small caps lag at -11.6023 and the semis relative holds -8.7539.

supporting_signals.claim: The tape took the yield surge in stride: 13 of 22 sectors/themes closed positive, led by AI Infrastructure +1.897, Semiconductor Equipment +1.5281, Networking +1.2374 and Semiconductors +1.0052.
Volatility disarmed the move: VIX eased to 14.21 from 14.87 and realized volatility printed 10.7178 — the calmest block in the composite.
Credit stayed calm in absolute terms: IG OAS at 0.79 and HY OAS at 2.8 remain near tight levels even after the week's rise.
AI capex headlines kept the hardware bid alive — Musk flagged that Colossus 2 could double its NVIDIA chip count by year-end — and Consumer Electronics added +1.122.

contradicting_signals.claim: The rates leg is a two-day-old vintage: the newest FRED observations are dated 2026-09-23, so Friday's exact close is not yet in the data — direction agrees with the day's yield-surge coverage (Fed speakers, market media), but the level awaits the next vintage.
The consumer leg contradicts the good-outlook narrative: September U-Mich sentiment fell to a four-month low and one-year inflation expectations rose to 4.6 percent.
Leadership narrowed rather than broadened: Cybersecurity -2.132, Cloud Computing -1.1863 and Data Centers -1.0787 lagged while small caps sat at -11.6023 — a hardware rotation, not a broad risk-on.
The AI mega-caps themselves were mixed: NVDA -0.2672, AMD +0.0969 and MU +0.2203 barely moved, while TSLA fell 1.7596.

what_changed_today: Volatility eased against the rate move: VIX 14.87 → 14.21, realized volatility 10.7178.
Liquidity: reverse repo 0.63 → 0.576, reserves 3013794 → 2930193, Treasury account 877028 → 977084.
Hardware rotation: AI Infrastructure +1.897 and Semiconductor Equipment +1.5281 led, while Cybersecurity -2.132 and Autos -1.7596 lagged.
Crude oil settled lower after Iran signaled willingness to restore the memorandum; the energy premium thinned.
watch_next: The FOMC meeting on 2026-09-28 at 18:00Z — guidance against the FedWatch-implied 4.175 is the pivot.
The next FRED vintage (2026-09-24 and 2026-09-25 observations) to confirm where the 10-year closed the week.
JOLTS on 2026-09-29, GDP and PCE on 2026-09-30, and the Employment Situation on 2026-10-02 — the labor-inflation mix the Fed hinges on.
Whether breadth can improve from a thin base: 0.0387 new highs versus 0.0452 new lows.
Whether crypto holds its footing into the FOMC window: BTC at 84002 with a -0.64739 session.

bull_case.title: Soft-landing glide continues
points: A held-rate, softer-guidance FOMC on 2026-09-28 unwinds the implied 4.175 and fades the discount-rate shock.
The next FRED vintage showing the 10-year closing back below 5.11 would pull the macro block down from 68.5.
Hardware leadership (AI Infrastructure +1.897) broadening into software would lift breadth above 0.6.

base_case.title: Narrow rotation under high rates
points: The composite drifts in the low-to-mid 40s: the 10-year stays near 5.11, VIX holds in the mid 14s and hardware keeps leadership into the FOMC.
Liquidity keeps thinning slowly (reserves 2930193, Treasury account 977084) without cracking credit (HY OAS 2.8).

bear_case.title: Real rates and liquidity squeeze
points: A hawkish 2026-09-28 FOMC with the real rate at the 100th percentile pushes the 10-year beyond 5.11 and forces equities to re-price.
Reserve drain plus a rebuilt Treasury account (2930193 / 977084) widens HY OAS beyond 2.8 and the narrow leadership reverses hard.
The consumer leg — one-year inflation expectations at 4.6 percent, sentiment at a four-month low — breaks the good-outlook narrative that is lifting yields.
